cafe_info.name: Bistrot Chérie
cafe_info.tagline: Life is a party, and the table is a feast.
cafe_info.description: An energetic fusion of Parisian bistro elegance and Italian trattoria soul. Fresh pasta made daily at 5 AM, natural wines from small European vineyards, and late-night vinyl records.

location.address: 34 Rue des Archives, Le Marais, 75004 Paris, France
location.landmark: Le Marais district near Place des Vosges

menu.name: Paneer Tikka
menu.description: Marinated cottage cheese cubes chargrilled with crisp bell peppers, onions, and aromatic herbs.

menu.name: Tagliatelle al Tartufo
menu.description: Hand-rolled egg pasta with 36-month aged Parmigiano Reggiano, cultured French butter, and fresh Norcia black truffle shaved tableside.

menu.name: Burrata Pugliese & Pêches Rôties
menu.description: Creamy 250g Puglia burrata paired with roasted white peaches, 25-year aged Modena balsamic, wild thyme, and toasted Sicilian pistachios.

menu.name: Côte de Boeuf à la Fiorentina
menu.description: Dry-aged 45-day Chianina beef ribeye grilled over olive wood embers, served with bone marrow jus, roasted garlic bulb, and crispy rosemary potatoes.

menu.name: Arancini al Ragù di Cervo
menu.description: Crispy saffron risotto spheres filled with slow-braised venison ragù and molten smoked scamorza cheese.

menu.name: Pappardelle al Cinghiale
menu.description: Wide ribbon pasta with 12-hour braised wild boar ragù, juniper berries, and crushed Valdostana chestnuts.

menu.name: Polpo alla Griglia con Nduja
menu.description: Charred Mediterranean octopus tentacle over smoky Cannellini bean puree, spicy Calabrian Nduja emulsion, and pickled shallots.

menu.name: Tiramisu au Calvados
menu.description: Savoiardi soaked in single-origin Ethiopian espresso and aged Normandy Calvados, layered with whipped mascarpone and dark Valrhona 70% chocolate shavings.

menu.name: Cannoli Siciliani al Pistacchio
menu.description: Crispy fried pastry shells stuffed with sweet sheep ricotta, candied Amalfi lemon peel, and crushed Bronte pistachios.

menu.name: Chérie Spritz Royale
menu.description: Select Aperitivo infused with fresh raspberries, Italicus Bergamot liqueur, organic Prosecco Superiore, and a dash of sparkling soda.

menu.name: Smoky Mezcal Paloma Italian
menu.description: Oaxacan Mezcal, Solerno Blood Orange Liqueur, fresh ruby red grapefruit juice, lime, and smoked sea salt rim.

menu.name: Artisanal Espresso
menu.description: Single-origin Ethiopian roast espresso with rich crema and dark cocoa notes.

menu.name: Cappuccino Chérie
menu.description: Velvety micro-foamed milk over rich double espresso with Valrhona dusting. Oat milk available on request.

best_seller.name: Tagliatelle al Tartufo
best_seller.description: Hand-rolled egg pasta with 36-month aged Parmigiano Reggiano, cultured French butter, and fresh Norcia black truffle shaved tableside. Our #1 chef signature and most loved dish.

faq.question: What time do you open?
faq.answer: We are open from 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM every day (Paris flagship opens 12:00 PM - 01:30 AM).

faq.question: What is the price of paneer tikka?
Do you have vegetarian options?
faq.answer: Yes! We have several vegetarian options including Paneer Tikka (₹299), Tagliatelle al Tartufo (€28), Burrata Pugliese (€21), and Cannoli Siciliani (€12).

faq.question: Where are you located?
faq.answer: Our flagship café is located at 34 Rue des Archives in Le Marais, Paris. We also have locations in Milano (Via Fiori Chiari 18) and New York (142 Spring Street).

faq.question: Do you offer takeaway?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer takeaway for all menu items. You can order at the counter or call ahead for pickup.

faq.question: Do you offer delivery?
faq.answer: Yes, delivery is available through select courier partners.

faq.question: Can I make a reservation?
faq.answer: Yes, you can reserve a table online through our website or by calling +33 1 42 68 55 90.

faq.question: Do you have outdoor seating?
faq.answer: Yes, we have a lovely outdoor terrace with heating and sun protection.
